source_repo: ttrrei/moneta (read-only reference; code NOT copied into lyra)
note: 132 single-indicator rule strategies in Python (strategy_*_lib.py). 28 have matrix results, all on 3 instruments (EUR_USD/BTC_USD/XAU_USD) vs buy-hold; most lose to buy-hold. Not YAML, not part of the 0008 regression gate. Triage target for 0010. 27 registered libraries (S01-S27) have dedicated strategy_*_lib.py; the other 105 (S28-S132) are legacy sweep strategies registered via run_matrix.py _SWEEP_MODULES/legacy runner (lib_file=null).
